sections.label: Frequently asked questions
sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
texts: Answers to immediate questions before submitting an inquiry.
How do I track my live order?

Once a restaurant confirms your meal prep, you can follow your courier's GPS location live within the FoodOrder mobile application or via the web tracker link sent to your SMS. The tracker displays live estimated arrival time, vehicle type, and direct encrypted chat with your courier.
What are the fees for multi-tenant merchant onboarding?

We offer transparent, commission-tiered pricing starting with a 0% setup fee and no hidden terminal charges. We provide customized packages for standalone family kitchens as well as national multi-tenant franchises. Contact
to receive an individualized tier breakdown.
How do I report a missing item or allergy concern?

Navigate to "My Orders", tap your active or recent receipt, and tap "Help with Order". Our automated resolution engine triggers an instant refund, kitchen remake, or driver redelivery within 90 seconds without requiring you to wait on hold.
Can I schedule recurring orders for my office team?

Yes! Our Corporate Catering portal lets office managers set recurrent lunch calendars, group budgets, and dietary filter preferences with aggregated consolidated monthly billing. Contact our B2B team to launch a pilot week for your company.
